show.description: Trapped in a loveless contract marriage, a man’s devotion is met with betrayal and humiliation. Years later, he returns as a self-made billionaire, finding true respect and love in someone new. A gripping tale of heartbreak, revenge, and redemption—where dignity triumphs over regret.
